sql.model_proposal:
SELECT vm.name AS instance_name, port.ipAddress AS ip_address, vol.name AS volume_name, vol.size AS volume_size, router.name AS vpc_name
FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA vm
LEFT JOIN CLOUD_PORT port ON vm.resId = port.devId
LEFT JOIN CLOUD_ROUTER router ON port.devNativeId = router.nativeId
LEFT JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM rvm ON vm.id = rvm.vmId
LEFT JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME vol ON rvm.volumeId = vol.id
